title: Technology Sector Update for 08/17/2018: NVDA,TIK,VJET
text:

Technology stocks were weaker in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing nearly 0.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was dropping almost 1.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
- Nvidia ( NVDA ) dropped as much as 5% on Friday after the specialty chipmaker cut its FY18 revenue forecast below analyst projections amid falling demand for cryptocurrency-related semiconductors and upstaging better-than-expected Q2 financial results, including a 40% year-over-year surge in revenue. Excluding one-time items, Nvidia earned $1.94 per share during the three months ended July 29 and easily exceeding the Capital IQ consensus of $1.84 per share. Group sales soared to $3.12 billion from $2.23 billion last yea and also beat the $3.11 billion Street view. Despite the weaker outlook, analysts at Oppenheimer Friday raised their investment rating for the company's stock to Outperform from Perform.
In other sector news:
+ Tel-Instrument Electronics ( TIK ) soared Friday after the avionics and airborne communication equipment company said saying the German government has told its UK distributor it plans to award a multi-year, multi-million dollar contract for up to 275 of its TS-4530A Mode 5 test sets, although an unsuccessful bidder has filed a protest, which must be first resolved prior to a formal contract award. awarded. The company also said it is pursuing additional equity financing to support planned growth in its business, adding the deal likely will be completed by Sept. 30.
- voxeljet AG ( VJET ) declined Friday, at one point dropping almost 7%, after the 3-D printer company reported below-consensus Q2 financial results, including an EUR0.15 per American depositary share on EUR5.3 million in revenue. Analysts, on average, had been expecting voxeljet to report a EUR0.07 per share net loss on EUR7.36 million in revenue. The company also is projecting Q3 revenue in a range of EUR6.0 million to EUR8.0 million and FY19 revenue between EUR28.0 million to EUR30.0 million, trailing analyst forecasts by around $900,000 and $2.98 million for Q3 and FY18, respectively.
